entities.name: Filipe de Brito e Nicote
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Filipe de Brito e Nicote or Nga Zinga, also called Zwing Gaa Bu (ဇွင်ဂါဘူ), was a Portuguese adventurer and mercenary in the service of the Arakanese kingdom of Mrauk U, and later of the Siamese Kingdom of Ayutthaya. His name is also recorded with the French spelling Philippe de Brito.
